headline: China’s Deyu lands in Dar in mission to deepen diplomatic ties, upgrade TAZARA standards
summary: China's Deputy Foreign Minister Miao Deyu arrived in Dar es Salaam for an official visit to deepen bilateral ties. Discussions are set to cover the upgrade of TAZARA railway standards.
why: TAZARA is the Tanzania-Zambia railway financed by China, and its upgrade affects regional freight logistics for landlocked Zambia.
